children: METLEN AND SHELL SIGN LONG-TERM LNG SUPPLY AGREEMENT
METLEN: SHELL GLOBAL LNG WILL SUPPLY METLEN WITH SIX LNG CARGOES ANNUALLY FROM 2027 FOR FIVE-YEAR PERIOD
METLEN ENERGY & METALS: SHELL WILL SUPPLY METLEN WITH SIX LNG CARGOES PER YEAR, AMOUNTING TO ABOUT 0.6 BCMA OVER 5-YEAR PERIOD COMMENCING IN 2027
METLEN: LNG CARGOES WILL BE DELIVERED TO METLEN, PRIMARILY SOURCED FROM SHELL’S US LNG PORTFOLIO, FOR SUPPLY TO GREECE OR OTHER EUROPEAN GAS MARKETS
